body.purpose: Forms, labels, dashboard detail, and reading copy.

motion.name: attention-refresh
motion.purpose: A brief sign-like flap marks a fresh dashboard response.

components.name: Primary Form Button
components.description: Full-width sign-yellow form action with an explicit verb.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 15px; background: var(--sign-yellow); color: #111111; font: 700 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #111111; color: var(--sign-yellow); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Rail Action Button
components.description: Outlined account action that reverses to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-rail-button { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 9px; background: transparent; color: #111111; font: 650 13px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-button:hover { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-rail-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.65; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field with an explicit focus border and keyboard ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 650 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 9px 11px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover:not(:focus-visible) { border-color: var(--muted); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus); outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: Functional destination with a compact pictogram inset and white active surface.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #111111; font: 650 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:not(.ds-nav-link-active):hover { background: rgba(17,17,17,0.12); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; width: 27px; height: 27px; place-items: center; border-radius: 3px; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Attention Band
components.description: One sign-yellow callout counts due work and points directly to its list.
components.html:
2 items need attention

1 maintenance schedule is overdue · 1 document expires within 30 days

Review due work →
components.css: .ds-attention { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; min-height: 64px; padding: 11px 16px; background: var(--sign-yellow); color: #111111; } .ds-attention strong { font: 700 18px/1.2 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-attention p { margin: 3px 0 0; font: 400 14px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-attention a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid #111111; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 10px; color: #111111; font: 700 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-attention a:hover { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-attention a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Fleet Status Strip
components.description: A continuous five-column strip keeps fleet totals compact without separate cards.
components.css: .ds-status { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-block: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-status > div { min-width: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-status > div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-status strong { display: block; font: 700 27px/1 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status span { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Due Work Row
components.description: Readable operational detail with a text status and restrained urgency color.
components.html:
ET-0148 · Oil and filter serviceDue Nov 10, 2026 · 48,320 km current / 48,000 km due
Overdue
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 62px; padding: 10px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); } .ds-work-row > div { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 2px; } .ds-work-row strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 650 16px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-work-row span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-work-row .ds-critical { color: var(--critical); font: 700 13px/1.45 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Fleet Wayfinding makes the next operational decision easy to locate. The visual language borrows the direct hierarchy of international airport signs: a saturated yellow navigation rail, one action band for due work, compact white pictograms in black insets, and clear high-contrast type. The mood is precise, direct, and operational; controls feel tactile and confident without turning the dashboard into a stack of decorative cards.

The interface supports fleet managers and operations leads who need to scan readiness, overdue work, and cost context quickly. Yellow is reserved for wayfinding and the next action. Maintenance and document states use explicit text alongside restrained status color. The light and dark themes share the same structure and preserve the yellow sign system.
keyCharacteristics: A single yellow navigation rail and one next-action band establish orientation.
Fleet measures use a compact strip; operational work stays in readable rows.
Borders and spacing provide hierarchy instead of shadows or nested cards.
Every live operational value comes from the API; no simulated GPS or demo records are implied.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks wayfinding and the next action; do not spread it across unrelated metrics or status labels.

rules.name: The Sign-First Rule
rules.body: Headings carry the hierarchy; do not add decorative eyebrow labels or uppercase section numbering.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to dashboard containers; use the existing surface and divider vocabulary.

dos: Keep the yellow sign system singular and purposeful.
Use real API values, explicit currency codes, and visible data dates.
Preserve semantic headings, visible focus, and text status labels.
Keep loading, error, empty, and disabled states explicit.
donts: Do not imply live GPS, integrations, or sample data are operational facts.
Do not turn the page into a grid of interchangeable KPI cards.
Do not use color alone to communicate urgency.
Do not add ornamental gradients, heavy shadows, or decorative badges.
